claims.statement: The project uses pytest as its test runner with configuration defined in pytest.ini.
Tests are categorized using pytest markers 'unit' for fast tests without external dependencies and 'integration' for tests requiring browser, network, or file I/O.
Stream validation tests in tests/test_streams.py verify the structure of stream URLs in index.html and video/index.html without requiring network access.

Syntax check tests in tests/test_syntax.py validate HTML, JavaScript, Markdown, and CSS files for balanced tags and proper syntax, excluding directories like .venv, node_modules, __pycache__, .git, dist, build, and .pytest_cache.
Website integration tests in tests/test_website.py use Playwright to test index.html, video/index.html, and impressum/index.html rendering and functionality.
Electron build verification tests in tests/test_electron_build.py validate that package.json contains proper Electron builder configuration and that required files and dependencies are present.
All test files located in the tests/ directory are automatically discovered and executed by pytest.
